# switzerlanding.com

> > A curated collection of visitor resources for Washington DC attractions and entertainment streaming guides, focusing on timed-entry museums, Smithsonian institutions, and Netflix recommendations.

This site aggregates essential planning information for DC tourism (National Mall museums, Smithsonian facilities, U.S. Capitol) alongside entertainment guides for streaming content. The resources emphasize advance booking requirements and visitor logistics for free attractions that require timed-entry passes.

## Key Topics

- Timed-entry passes
- Washington DC museums
- Smithsonian institutions
- National Air and Space Museum
- National Zoo
- U.S. Capitol and Capitol Visitor Center
- National Museum of African American History and Culture
- Netflix streaming recommendations
- Free DC attractions
- Advance reservations
- Museum ticket requirements
- National Mall
- Group tours
- Visitor planning guides
- Entertainment streaming guides

## DC Museum Entry & Reservations

- [Book Your Passes | Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute](https://nationalzoo.si.edu/passes/entry): Entry pass booking for Smithsonian's National Zoo with member benefits
- [Visit the Museum in DC, Free Timed-Entry Passes Required | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/visit/museum-dc): National Air and Space Museum DC location visitor info & pass reservations

## DC Visitor Planning Guides

- [Which Attractions & Museums in Washington, DC Require Tickets? | Washington DC](https://washington.org/dc-faqs-for-visitors/which-attractions-require-tickets): FAQ guide to ticketed & timed-entry DC attractions and museums
- [Timed Entry Information for 6 Free DC Attractions | Washington DC](https://washington.org/groups/timed-entry-free-dc-attractions): Group tour guide for timed entry at 6 free DC attractions including museums

## Entertainment & Streaming Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide homepage with TV listings, schedules, and entertainment news
- [The 55 Best Shows on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of 55 best Netflix shows including Vladimir and Bridgerton
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Top 61 Netflix movies featuring Jurassic World Rebirth and The Iron Claw
- [The Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026: Everything to Know About What to Watch This Season - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Seasonal TV preview guide for Winter 2025-2026 across all streamers

## Optional

- [ABOUT Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com](https://dictionary.com/browse/about): Dictionary.com definition entry for preposition/adverb 'about'
